description: Consistency with continuity (CWC) / free-stream preservation for the REGIONAL LATERAL-INFLOW monotone PPM scheme on a limited-area latlon patch (lon [0,60], lat [20,60], no poles, no zonal wrap) at 12x9x4 -- the open-boundary counterpart of latlon3d_transport_cwc_3d_ppm. Four rules fire: two bare-D open-wall continuity divergences (lon, lat) and two compound monotone PPM flux-form inflow rules carrying the tracer with a prescribed Dirichlet halo qbc. At q == 1 with halo == 1 the reconstruction of the uniform halo is exactly uniform, every open wall flux collapses to F = M bitwise, and dev = mq - m stays 0. MEASURED (julia, Tsit5, reltol 1e-10 / abstol 1e-12): dev = 0.0 exactly at t=0 and t=0.1. The reference is the constant zero, so non-vacuity is established separately by problems/_falsifier_regional_inflow.esm (all four qbc halos x 1.000001), which injects a mismatched inflow concentration through the west/south walls and drives dev off zero, correctly failing -- re-run it if this problem changes. Only the t=0.1 assertion discriminates: dev is a state with dev(0)=0 by construction. See README.md.

scope_excluded.rust: rank-3 makearray flux-form transport; not exercised by the rust binding's simulator
scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.python: With the esm-0.9.0 D-trailing-operand fix (EarthSciAST feat/d-trailing-operands: rewrite-target D may carry trailing boundary/halo operands), earthsci_ast now LOADS both problems -- the former arity rejection (`operator 'D' accepts at most 1 args, got 3`) is gone. The case remains julia-only for a DIFFERENT, downstream reason: the python vectorized simulator raises `index 4 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 4` during simulate on the inflow-halo (trailing boundary-operand) indexing. This is NOT the general rank-3 flux-form gap -- python runs rank-3 makearray flux-form transport (latlon3d_transport_cwc_3d / _cwc_3d_ppm / _cwc_moving_lid all pass on python); it is specific to the Dirichlet inflow-halo path and needs root-causing before python can be armed here. MEASURED 2026-07-23/24 (LSODA 1e-10/1e-12): loads OK (~104-156 s), then errors in simulate; 0 assertions run. Julia (reference) runs it. Re-classify once the OOB is fixed.
